headline: The Fed’s Christopher Waller Warns of Higher Rates Soon if Inflation Stays High
context: Christopher J. Waller, a governor at the Federal Reserve, said he needed to see several months of lower inflation data to feel confident about the outlook.

sources.name: The New York Times
